title: Cleaner Home progress and accurate ARP
details: Milos-observed ACs and KSBs are no longer shown as an observed summary on the Evia Home screen
Assessor-observed ACs and KSBs remain visible inside the AC/KSB arch coverage menus
ARP now starts at 0% when no Assessment Readiness & Practice activity has been attempted
The ARP Home percentage is calculated only from actual Multiple Choice, Discussion and Practical practice history
Existing Milos observed coverage, NVQ P/T themes and unit views are preserved
